description:
Memorial lists with many names. Recto of the larger fragment is for the descendants of the early 11th-century Gaʾon Yoshiyyahu (here titled Rosh Yeshivat Geʾon Yaʿaqov). The names include: Yoshiy[yahu]; his son Aharon Av Bet Din; his son Yoshiyya Av Bet Din; his son Ṣadoq ha-Ṣadiq Av Bet Din; his sons: probably Moshe ha-Rav ha-Muvhaq and Hillel; [...]; Shemuʾel ha-Rav; [...]; Yoshiyyahu; [...]; Elʿazar; [...]; someone called [[Keter ha-Teʾuda]] Keter ha-Tevuna; someone called Sar Bet Yisraʾel ve-Yehuda; Meʾir ha-Rav ha-Muvhaq; someone known as ha-Nagid ha-Gadol; and Moshe.

Verso and the second fragment contain different but possibly related lists.
